notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds; business-type on accrual (as FY2024). Governmental statement lines, transfers and fund balances from the Total Governmental Funds column of the governmental funds statement (p6, right half; row labels on p5). Roll-forward: 2,520,315 + 3,548,688 - 3,713,885 + 810,191 - 479,765 = 2,685,544 (p6). Cash not recorded at the top level (as FY2024; cash and restricted cash/CDs are on the balance sheet). Business-type from the proprietary statement Total column (pp9-10): receipts = operating revenues + nonoperating interest, grant revenue, gain on sale and miscellaneous income (computed; no single printed total); disbursements 5,123,971 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 5,115,124 + interest 5,982 + loan fees 2,865; transfers (330,426) to governmental funds. 16,473,001 + 7,006,710 - 5,123,971 - 330,426 = 18,025,314. Operating 'Other revenue' 185,984 is charges for services: the Statement of Activities counts it there. Proprietary cash-flow statement (pp11-13) not recorded (as FY2024). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1; component units excluded). Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp22-23), which supersedes the General Fund budget schedule (pp14-15, not recorded); Zoning and Cemetery kept under general government / health-welfare as in FY2024 although the statement groups them in public works. Street, Sales Tax, CDA, Economic Development and Grant funds from their budget schedules (pp16-20; lines with no actual amount omitted, Sales Tax Fund has no actual expenditures); nonmajor funds per fund (p21). No enterprise fund schedules. Read pages 1-23 of 23
